title: A UAP class attacks with microwave weapons and shuts down systems

tellings.quote: And there is another class, which actually attacked us microwave weapons. That is, they actually turned off ours systems. Translated everything

plain: James Valor, from a startup called Skywatcher that says it tries to call in UFOs, which officials now call UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, says that his team has run into different types of these objects in recent years. He says one type actually attacked them with microwave weapons and shut down their equipment, which if true would mean some of these objects are hostile.
